name: swe-rebench-v2-runtime
description: Runtime plugin for the swe-rebench-v2.v1 SolverNet — provides domain reference for task shape, repo handling, FAIL_TO_PASS / PASS_TO_PASS semantics, and the solution payload schema.

interface.longDescription: Provides Solver-side domain reference for SWE-rebench v2 code-issue tasks — task input shape, repo handling, FAIL_TO_PASS / PASS_TO_PASS semantics, and the swe-rebench-v2-solution.v1 payload schema.
